title: Hold the Ferry Line
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: driving cinematic underscore, ticking percussion like a clock, low brass and pulsing strings, a heroic horn theme rising, steady and relentless, no vocals

shots.prompt: A port town on a narrow sea strait at dusk: families with bags waiting on a long quay as two white passenger ferries load, cars queued, gulls overhead, hills on the far shore, warm but anxious light.
shots.line: A whole town is waiting on the quay.

shots.prompt: Three roads winding down through dry hills toward a port town at dusk, a dust cloud of an approaching armoured column on each road, dark vehicles with no markings, menacing, wide view from a hilltop.
shots.line: Orion Group is coming down all three roads to take the strait back.

shots.prompt: Keep this man's face, hair, moustache and uniform exactly. Move him to a harbour wall at dusk with white ferries loading behind him, wind in the air, resolute, looking at the viewer.
shots.line: Colonel Kemal Aydın has twelve minutes and three roads to hold.

shots.prompt: A young woman commando in 1950s fatigues, dark hair tied back, listening intently to a modern military radio handset in a harbour command post at dusk, glowing screens around her, her face tense with recognition.
shots.line: On the radio, a calm voice makes an offer. Tanya knows that voice.

shots.prompt: Two white ferries crossing a narrow strait at night, their lights reflected on the dark water, a grey warship escorting them, the port town glowing behind, hopeful.
